name: GD Evolve
description: Recreates an image from real GD objects using evolution (random object ID, hue, saturation, brightness, size, rotation, position, z order).

time-limit.name: Time limit (seconds, 0 = none)
time-limit.description: Stops when the time OR the object count is reached, whichever is first.

simple-shapes.name: Only simple shapes
simple-shapes.description: Skip gears, chains and other complex objects.

complexity.name: Shape complexity limit
complexity.description: Higher allows more complex objects. Squares are ~16, triangles ~21.

bg.name: Transparent background colour
bg.description: Hex colour used where the image is transparent.

opacity-levels.name: Opacity levels (1 = off)
opacity-levels.description: 2-4 adds translucent objects (better blending). Uses Color triggers, so opacity shows when you play the level, not in the editor.
